title: Best Voice AI Platforms for Shopify Stores With Phone Support
summary: Compare voice AI platforms for Shopify phone support, including order lookups, returns calls, Gorgias handoffs, live transfers, and integration requirements.
body_markdown:
## TL;DR


For Shopify stores with substantial phone volume, this comparison examines how SigmaMind AI, Retell AI, and Bland AI could support order inquiries and transfers to a person. The comparison uses the published documentation cited here; it does not report hands-on tests. Shopify supplies store and order data, and Gorgias may manage support work. A separate voice platform handles calls. None of the cited vendor materials documents a complete Shopify refund workflow.


- **SigmaMind AI:** Best for established phone-support operations that need to work with existing telephony and CRM systems. Its[Shopify connection requires custom-app setup](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/app-integration/shopify.md) , while[warm transfers can pass a call summary](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/transfer-call.md) .
- **Retell AI:** A candidate for a custom Shopify phone workflow, pending product documentation and a demonstration. The cited sources do not document how Retell AI connects to Shopify or Gorgias.
- **Bland AI:** A candidate for a custom inbound-call evaluation if Bland AI can demonstrate the required phone workflows and Shopify access. The cited sources do not verify Bland AI's Shopify connection or support-ticket handoff.


## What this comparison covers and who it's for


Shopify stores with substantial inbound call volume need a voice platform that works with their phone setup and can transfer callers to a person. A chat agent that handles storefront messages does not provide those phone workflows by itself. This comparison assesses published evidence for SigmaMind AI, Retell AI, and Bland AI.


Gorgias AI Agent, Ada, Sierra, Decagon, and Intercom Fin are outside this phone-platform comparison. If you use one of them for customer service, assess its spoken-call capabilities separately.


For each voice platform, we examine whether you can verify a caller before sharing order details, retrieve order or return information with read-only access, and cover calls after hours or during seasonal peaks. We also look at safe escalation and whether a live agent receives the caller’s context during transfer. A claimed Shopify or Gorgias connection alone does not prove that a platform can perform those steps.


## How we evaluated each platform


We reviewed the cited materials for order and return access, caller verification, and transfers that pass context to a live agent. We did not test live deployments. The cited materials do not include Retell AI or Bland AI product documentation, so their capabilities and relative fit remain unverified.


A useful Shopify integration must have permission to perform the specific order operations the phone workflow requires. Shopify API access depends on the data and actions a workflow uses. For an app that reads orders through the Shopify Admin API, order lookup generally requires read_orders. Access to[orders older than 60 days](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order) also requires read_all_orders; confirm Shopify’s applicable access requirements for the app. Check the[applicable Shopify access scopes](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/access-scopes#orders-permissions) for return lookups and refund actions rather than treating read access as permission to issue a refund. We did not treat read access as evidence that a platform can issue refunds. Likewise, a Gorgias connection did not count as ticket or call-summary handoff unless published materials documented that workflow.


### SigmaMind AI


SigmaMind AI fits Shopify brands that already handle substantial phone volume through a dialer or contact-center platform. If you use VICIdial, Five9, NICE, or Genesys, ask SigmaMind AI whether it supports your deployment. Request a demonstration of inbound routing and transfer to an agent. Confirm the implementation work, test the Shopify lookup, and measure call latency in your configuration.


We evaluated SigmaMind AI’s published setup guides, not a live Shopify phone deployment. The[Shopify guide](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/app-integration/shopify.md) describes creating a custom app, granting Admin API permissions, and entering its access token through Integration Auth. Grant only the Shopify scopes needed for the lookup you implement, and confirm those scopes against the API operations it calls. You must still configure the lookup, verify the caller before disclosing order details, and test failures. The guide does not demonstrate safely automated refunds.


The[Gorgias guide](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/app-integration/gorgias.md) documents synchronization of macros, tags, rules, and FAQs. The cited guide does not establish automatic ticket creation or call-summary writing. For escalation, SigmaMind AI’s[Transfer Call tool](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/transfer-call.md) supports cold transfers without context and warm transfers that can give the receiving agent a private whisper summary. The Transfer Call documentation also describes optional SIP headers for structured context. Configure transfer destinations and triggers, then test whether your phone system makes that context available to the receiving agent. Writing a Gorgias ticket requires separate implementation and verification.


- **Best for** Established phone-support operations that can configure Shopify data access and test agent handoffs.
- **Pros:** Documented warm-transfer options and Shopify custom-app setup.
- **Cons:** The cited guides do not demonstrate a complete Shopify phone workflow, automated refunds, or automatic Gorgias ticket handoff.
- **Pricing:** Request a current quote that identifies the pricing model, included services, telephony charges, and any concurrency charges.


### Retell AI


Assess Retell AI against your Shopify phone requirements using its product documentation and a workflow demonstration. An order-status call needs more than a voice agent. Your implementation must verify the caller, retrieve the permitted order record, and decide what the agent can safely say or pass to a person.


This article cites no Retell AI product documentation establishing a Shopify or Gorgias connector or a transfer that preserves order context. Request published documentation for the phone and CRM integrations you need, then ask Retell AI to demonstrate the workflow in your phone setup. Do not assume that[Gorgias’s Shopify actions](https://updates.gorgias.com/publications/shopify-actions-for-ai-agent) extend to a Retell AI call.


Ask Retell AI for current pricing and evidence for the latency or compliance requirements that matter to your deployment.


**Best for:** Buyers evaluating a custom Shopify phone workflow, subject to product verification.
**Potential fit:** Evaluate whether Retell AI supports the identity checks and order-lookup rules your custom implementation requires.
**Cons:** The cited materials do not verify Shopify access, Gorgias handoff, or context-preserving transfers. Request evidence for any performance or compliance claims before relying on them.
**Pricing:** Confirm current rates and what they include directly before budgeting.


### Bland AI


Bland AI requires a workflow demonstration before it can be assessed for Shopify phone support. The cited materials do not verify Bland AI’s Shopify order access, Gorgias connection, or ticket or call-summary handoff.


Bland AI’s inbound support workflow remains unverified in this comparison. Ask Bland AI to demonstrate caller verification, live transfer, and the work needed to access Shopify order data. If your calls have compliance requirements, assess those separately against documentation for your use case.


**Best for:** Buyers evaluating a custom ecommerce phone workflow, subject to product verification.


**Potential fit:** Evaluate Bland AI for a custom-built phone workflow after a product demonstration.


**Cons:** Shopify access, Gorgias handoff, and inbound support remain unverified in the cited materials.


**Pricing:** No published Bland AI pricing source is cited here; confirm current rates and what they include.

## What a real Shopify phone workflow requires


A Shopify phone agent should verify the caller before reading out order details. An order number or incoming phone number alone does not establish identity. Define which details the agent may compare with customer and order records. Specify what it must do after a failed match and what information it may disclose. SigmaMind AI’s[Shopify setup guide](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/app-integration/shopify.md) describes a custom app with configured Admin API scopes, but it does not establish a ready-made caller-verification flow.


A phone agent can retrieve only the orders its app is authorized to access. Shopify generally limits an app to the[most recent 60 days of orders](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order) unless it has the required access for older orders, including read_all_orders alongside an applicable order scope such as read_orders. Confirm the requirements for your app. A vendor’s “Shopify integration” claim alone does not establish that its phone agent can retrieve the orders your callers ask about.


Keep lookup permissions separate from actions that change an order. Permissions for reading order data do not, by themselves, authorize actions that change a return or issue a refund. Confirm the[Shopify scopes and API operations](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/access-scopes#orders-permissions) used for each proposed workflow before granting access. Keep refund approval with a person unless the vendor demonstrates the complete authorization and audit process.


For calls that exceed a verified read-only lookup, route the caller to a person with the call context intact. SigmaMind AI documents a[warm transfer](https://docs.sigmamind.ai/transfer-call.md) that can give the receiving agent a private summary before connecting the caller. A cold transfer sends no such context. Test whether your receiving phone system delivers the summary and whether any Gorgias ticket receives it, rather than assuming either handoff works automatically.


## Why SigmaMind AI fits established phone-support operations


SigmaMind AI merits an evaluation if your Shopify store already handles substantial inbound calls through Five9, NICE, Genesys, or VICIdial. The cited Shopify setup and transfer guides do not, on their own, establish a working connection to your particular phone deployment. Ask SigmaMind AI to show how an agent would connect to your existing phone system, follow your order-inquiry steps, and transfer a caller when the lookup cannot be completed.


A SigmaMind AI pilot should test seasonal call volume against your phone routes, order-access rules, and human handoffs. Ask how concurrent calls affect capacity and pricing, and confirm the current platform rate and any speech, model, and telephony charges. If the documented setup appears suitable,[ask SigmaMind AI about a pilot](https://dashboard.sigmamind.ai/p/signup) using your expected call volume and phone configuration.


## Call-quality monitoring and conversation accuracy


During a pilot, review recordings and transcripts of order-status, returns, after-hours, and transferred calls. Score whether the agent verified the caller before disclosure, used the right order record, stayed within approved actions, and passed useful context to a person. No comparable accuracy scores are cited for SigmaMind AI, Retell AI, or Bland AI. Use the same test calls and scoring rules for each vendor, and record whether errors involve identity checks, order selection, unsupported answers, or lost transfer context.


## FAQs


-


**Can a voice AI platform issue Shopify refunds during a call?** None of the cited documentation establishes a complete, safely automated Shopify refund workflow for the platforms compared here. Reading an order does not authorize a refund. Ask the vendor to identify the[Shopify permissions and API operations](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/access-scopes#orders-permissions) its proposed refund workflow uses and to demonstrate how a person approves the action.


-


**How does voice AI differ from a chat-based Shopify helpdesk AI?** A chat-based tool handles typed messages. A voice platform connects to your phone setup to answer spoken calls. Ask the vendor to demonstrate interruption handling and live transfer rather than assuming every platform supports them. Gorgias may hold useful support context, but using it as a helpdesk does not establish that a phone agent can access its records or pass call context into a ticket.


-


**What should I ask a vendor to demonstrate before buying?** Ask for a live call that verifies a caller, retrieves an order using specified Shopify API permissions, and transfers an unresolved case to a person. Check whether the receiving agent gets a whisper summary or other call context. Ask who builds the connections, what work remains for your staff, and how long implementation should take.


-


**How does after-hours or peak-season phone coverage work?** Your phone setup must route eligible calls to the voice agent when staff are unavailable or queues fill. The agent can handle approved lookups, but calls needing a person still require a defined route, such as a staffed transfer or callback request. Chat coverage does not answer calls unless a separate voice workflow connects to the phone system.


## Conclusion


For a broader vendor comparison, see the[conversational AI platform comparison for retail and ecommerce](https://www.sigmamind.ai/blog/best-conversational-ai-platforms-retail-ecommerce) . The Shopify–Recharge–Gorgias workflow guide and ecommerce order-status guide cover implementation details beyond this vendor comparison. For Shopify stores with substantial inbound call volume, prioritize verified order-data access and safe transfers to human agents. Before choosing a platform, ask each vendor to demonstrate caller verification, an authorized order lookup, and the information a live agent receives after transfer. Choose a platform that fits your existing phone and support systems, and account for the integration work you can maintain.
